_meta.description: Example request/response payloads for Module 2 (the single public endpoint of the delivered ai/Stress_Module microservice). Module 2A and Module 2B are internal-only -- these are NOT called directly by the frontend or by Django.
_meta.source: ai/Stress_Module/samples/sample_request.json and sample_response.json -- a real, live-captured response, not a fabricated example (see ai/Stress_Module/docs/INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md).
_meta.updated: 2026-09-18 -- resynced with the Stress Module's actual delivered v1.2.0 contract; the previous version of this file predated `recommendation_notes`, `module2a.input_typicality`, `module2a.model_version` and top-level `module2a_model_version`, and still showed the three meter readings as optional.

example_2_unsupported_crop._note: All 15 catalog crops are trained-and-supported as of module2a-v5 (2026-09-10) -- this response shape is retained for a crop value outside that list, which the Django serializer's categorical whitelist would normally reject with 422 before this branch is ever reached (module2_field_options.json -> crop_model_support). Shown for completeness of the documented contract, not a currently reachable example.

response.message: Nutrient and soil-condition analysis isn't available yet for this crop.

example_3_error_responses._note: From the Stress Module's own /predict, not Django's public /api/v1/module2/analyze/ (which always wraps errors in the existing {success, message} envelope, per REST_API_SPEC.md Section 8A). Shown here because ai_services/module2_client.py branches on these directly.
